title: Groundwork canvas feedback.jsonl row
description: Rail -> agent, one JSON object per line. The server appends exactly one row per accepted POST /__canvas/feedback, stamping `ts` and `id`; all other fields originate in the browser. The agent reads new rows each turn (cursor-tracked, dedup by `id`) and routes them into the decision engine.

id.description: SERVER-stamped, unique per row: fb-<epoch-ms>-<seq>. The agent's dedup key. NOTE: <seq> resets on server restart, so dedup MUST key on the full id string (which embeds the ms), not the seq alone.

kind.description: comment=Send; lock/lean/never=chips; decide=A/B; toggle=Live/Hold. v1 servers do NOT reject unknown kinds (agent ignores them); consumers MUST tolerate unknown kinds.

text.description: comment (required non-empty at the rail) / lock / lean / never. May be '' for chips.

component.description: data-component pin name if a pin was active, else null.

dim.description: decide only — echoed from status.json fork.dim.

value.description: decide only — the OPTION KEY 'a'|'b' (NOT the token value). The agent maps a/b to the real value via status.json fork.
